criteria.requirement: The view state must survive a full page reload
criteria.action: Load the fixture, set camera to [120,-80,640] with target [10,20,30], hide activation_1, disable rotation, reload, and inspect the restored scene and snapshot.
criteria.expected: Camera and target equal the supplied arrays, activation_1 remains invisible, input and dense_2 remain visible, labelsRotating is false, and the stored JSON has version 1. (Tolerance: 1e-5 absolute for every numeric component)

criteria.requirement: Each has nine vertices: x and y independently take `[-10,0,10]` in row-major order, while every z is respectively `-155`, `-105`, or `285`.
criteria.action: Call loadFixture and inspect all three live THREE.Points geometries and their names.
criteria.expected: There are exactly 27 vertices in three named objects, with the specified row-major coordinates and layer-specific constant z values. (Tolerance: 1e-5 absolute per coordinate)

criteria.requirement: It must retain the renderer, camera, OrbitControls, highlight box, and persisted view state.
criteria.action: Set a nondefault camera and hidden layer, load the fixture, invoke the existing CLEAR control, then reload the fixture.
criteria.expected: CLEAR leaves highlightBoxPresent true and preserves camera and settings; fixture layers are removed by CLEAR and reapplied with the same visibility when loaded again. (Tolerance: Exact object presence and visibility; numeric tolerance 1e-5)

criteria.requirement: Malformed JSON, a non-object root, or wrong `version` uses all defaults.
criteria.action: Before initialization, test malformed JSON, an array root, and version 2 in separate reloads, then inspect state and live camera.
criteria.expected: Each case uses position [0,0,5000], target [0,0,0], no hidden layers, and labelsRotating true without a runtime failure. (Tolerance: 1e-5 absolute for camera values; exact defaults otherwise)

criteria.requirement: without clearing the digit, prediction output, or activation geometry.
criteria.action: With fixture geometry and nonempty synthetic output present, hide a layer, move the camera, disable rotation, and activate RESET VIEW.
criteria.expected: All default view values are saved and live, all fixture layers are visible, and the output and 27 fixture vertices remain present. (Tolerance: Exact state and counts; numeric tolerance 1e-5)

criteria.requirement: while disabled, those rotations remain unchanged.
criteria.action: Create or stub two label pivots, record rotations, advance three animation frames with rotation disabled, then enable it and advance two frames.
criteria.expected: The first three frames produce no change; each subsequent frame adds exactly 0.015 to each pivot's y rotation. (Tolerance: 1e-5 absolute)

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial rendered 3D scene and its declared state. Inspect task-relevant depth and geometry across at least three views where appropriate, and inspect composition, materials, lighting, color, and legibility.
Exercise the central interaction and numeric or geometry contract through the visible UI. Verify meaningful scene/state feedback without inventing unrequested controls.
Repeat the boundary, invalid-input, recovery, and reset sequence while inspecting live scene state.
Inspect 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts, including lower controls and keyboard focus. Reload and inspect console/resource diagnostics.
